written_before: any gidi-en student was trained, exported or scored
label_provenance: silver-claude-clef; no human labels exist for English. All numbers are agreement with Claude+Clef labels, not ground truth.
contract: configs/annotation-en-v1.yaml, docs/annotation-en-v1.md. Clarifications fixed before final labelling (datasets/annotation-en-v1/work/gem-prompt.md): named merchants/services/platforms are targets (the guide's `uber home $18` row is treated as an outlier); salary-phrased notes (R4) have no target.

frozen_sets.test: datasets/annotation-en-v1/splits/test.jsonl (300 notes). Evaluation only: never used for prompts, few-shot, vocabulary, augmentation or training.
frozen_sets.dev: datasets/annotation-en-v1/splits/dev.jsonl (200 notes). Sanity checks and teacher accuracy only.
frozen_sets.seed: datasets/annotation-en-v1/splits/seed.jsonl (300 notes). Few-shot kNN pool for the Clef teacher only.
frozen_sets.train: datasets/annotation-en-v1/splits/train.jsonl (1,462 notes). Labels: datasets/annotation-en-v1/silver-train.jsonl (Clef 16-shot kNN teacher, pool = seed).

labels.test_dev_seed: two independent labelers (Gemini 3.8 flash, Clef zero-shot); agreement on type and target text = consensus, otherwise Claude adjudicated (labels-*.jsonl, provenance.jsonl source field)
labels.train: silver-train.jsonl; teacher dev accuracy is in report.md

eval_sets.primary: test notes with annotation_status complete and provenance source = consensus (n = 214): both independent labelers agree on type and target, the least contestable subset
eval_sets.secondary: all test notes with annotation_status complete (n = 290), including the 76 Claude-adjudicated hard ones

primary.note: target exact match = predicted span equals the labelled span string, null equals null, over all notes of the set

secondary.note: teacher on dev scored 0.915 type / 0.894 target over all complete notes and 0.789 / 0.702 on the adjudicated subset, so the student is not expected to beat the teacher on the hard notes

acceptance.rationale: A student distilled from the teacher is bounded near teacher quality. Primary thresholds sit at or just below the teacher's dev type/target accuracy on the consensus subset (0.970 / 0.977) with room for the capacity loss of a small model; secondary thresholds are about 0.09-0.12 below the teacher's all-notes dev numbers. The student passes only if both sets pass. Thresholds are not changed after seeing any student result.

contamination: no note of test or dev appears in train (SequenceMatcher >= 0.85 on normalised text or equal skeleton dropped from train); see splits/manifest.json
